ownership: Original RestoVisuals geometry and texture inputs
source_format: Wavefront OBJ with one MTL preview material
tangent_storage: Analytically derived here; OBJ stores no explicit tangents. FBX tangent export/import must be verified.

unknowns: native tangent handedness and V direction
full native property and flag baseline

source_texture_interpretation.diffuse: Original constant RGB8 128/128/128 PNG with an sRGB intent tag. Native color handling is unverified.
source_texture_interpretation.normal: Byte-identical Phase 0K experimental flat DDS; encoded 128/128/255, A=255, nine mips, DXGI 28. Native compatibility remains unknown.

authoring_route.source_to_fbx: Authorized DCC/MCP import into an isolated owned scene; verify units/basis; export selected mesh with supported legacy FBX 7400 and tangent space.
authoring_route.fbx_to_kn5: Future approved operator: ksEditor File > Open FBX, assign and verify material, File > Save KN5 to workspace only.

future_scene_requirements.scope: Pose proposals only; OBJ contains no spawn markers, cameras or track metadata.
required_before_game_load: validated model registration and collision/surface conventions
verified pit/start transforms and car clearance
required native metadata for the selected test mode

cold_recovery: End owned session; remove only reviewed owned configuration/resources; cold-load unchanged original KN5 and configuration; verify shader, slots, properties, flags, images and hashes.
licensing: Repository license remains owner-undecided; permanent freeware policy applies.
